Netic is hiring a new-graduate Forward Deployed Engineer to build and deploy AI agents for essential service businesses. The role combines AI development with direct customer collaboration, owning implementation and rollout while improving system scalability, performance, and the product roadmap.

Responsibilities
Architect agents: Build and ship multi-modal AI agents that drive business impact for essential service companies
Co‑build with customers: Work directly with enterprise stakeholders to map workflows and deploy our product to unlock immediate revenue lift
Own end‑to‑end lifecycle: Manage everything from design, to implementation, to rollout, including deployment, measuring success, and iterating with customers
Ensure scalability: Build reliable systems that support thousands of concurrent interactions with strong performance
Run rapid experiments: Evaluate cutting‑edge text/voice models, fine‑tune, live A/B test, and iterate within tight feedback loops
Elevate the platform: Surface patterns and opportunities across customers to inform product and engineering roadmaps

We need to hire multiple new graduates to join our FDE team that are available to start between winter of 2026 and summer of 2027
Experience building and maintaining production systems using Python (asyncio, FastAPI) and TypeScript (Node, React)
Hands-on experience with LLM, TTS and speech APIs, fine-tuning models, vector databases, RAG, and evaluation frameworks
Ability to meet SLAs, resolve issues, and optimize systems for speed and reliability at scale
Experience building production monitoring and debugging systems across cloud infrastructure and databases
Comfortable engaging directly with customers to troubleshoot issues, understand edge cases, and deliver fast solutions
